title: Help or Hinder? Evaluating the Impact of Fairness Metrics and Algorithms in Visualizations for Consensus Ranking
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a variable or focus of the study. The study's focus is on visualizing fairness metrics for consensus ranking based on socio-demographic groups, specifically race.
